info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Message Analysis API
info.description: The Financial Message Analysis API enables users to analyze and interpret financial message data within banking transactions. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve valuable insights and summaries of specific financial messages by providing relevant parameters. Ideal for financial institutions and banking application developers, this API supports use cases such as compliance checks, transaction monitoring, and reporting. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiencies and ensure adherence to regulatory standards.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the analysis for a specific financial message identified by its unique identifier. It provides insights and information pertaining to the financial transaction associated with the message.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve financial message analysis for the specified resource with ID RES-100045. It requires a JSON payload that contains parameters necessary for the analysis operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the financial message analysis data is returned.
